HARVEST_SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE.description: Source endpoint or archive service not reachable or timed out

HARVEST_PARSE_FAILURE.description: Unable to parse source payload or raw envelope schema invalid

HARVEST_RATE_LIMITED.description: Upstream rate limit or politeness policy triggered

EXTRACT_FIELD_MISSING.description: Required field not found in document or dossier

EXTRACT_UNSUPPORTED_MODALITY.description: Input format/modality not supported without OCR preprocessing

CATEGORY_INVARIANT_VIOLATION.description: Category schema invariant violated (e.g. missing notebook_id or duplicate entry)

CATEGORY_CONFLICT.description: Category or alias collision detected across canonical categories

PACK_VALIDATION_FAILED.description: Knowledge pack failed schema, provenance, or target verification rules
